Q: How to return value to user from a Search Help Exit A:

I agree with the forespeakers, that provided code is a mess, from which nothing can be figured out.

First of all, use DISP event in SHELP FM exit, not SELECT.

Secondly, you fill the wrong table (or do not show us right filling in the snippet above). In order to pass values back to user you should modify a RECORD_TAB table.

Your code should look something like this (joined selections from zsl_glk_apof and zsl_glk_apof_tr tables):

CHECK callcontrol-step = 'DISP'.
DATA: ls_selopt TYPE ddshselopt.  "loc str for shlp-selopt
DATA: BEGIN OF ls_record.
      INCLUDE STRUCTURE seahlpres.
DATA: END OF ls_record.
DATA: lv_glk_apof_tr TYPE zsl_glk_apof_tr-apofasisap_tr.

LOOP AT shlp-selopt INTO ls_selopt.

* finding SKOPOS and KATDANL values
  CASE ls_selopt-shlpfield.
   WHEN 'SKOPOS'.
    lv_skopos = ls_selopt-low.
   WHEN 'KATDANL'.
    lv_katdanl = ls_selopt-low.
   WHEN OTHERS.
  ENDCASE.

  * doing smth

  * finding some stuff from Z-tables
  SELECT SINGLE tr~apofasisap_tr
  FROM zsl_glk_apof AS ap
  JOIN zsl_glk_apof_tr AS tr
   ON ap~apofasisap = tr~apofasisap_trp
  INTO lv_glk_apof_tr
   WHERE ap~apofasi = lv_apofasi.
ENDLOOP.

* modify record_tab with the found value lv_glk_apof_tr
LOOP AT record_tab INTO ls_record.
  ls_record-string+25(5) = lv_glk_apof_tr.  "field shift should be based on your values
ENDLOOP.

Q: Microsoft Excel Security Warning - Pop Up A:

Answer for those who encountered the same error on Windows 11. I tried all the methods I found and nothing helped. Having gone through all 5 stages of acceptance, I finally decided to reinstall the system while saving the files. That helped. BUT! When I installed Crypto pro CSP (КРИПТО ПРО) version 4, the error appeared again. Updating to version 5 helped. In my case, the error apparently occurred due to incorrect root certificates. I hope that if this does not solve your problem, it will at least give you an idea of how to solve it. I myself spent two days and a bunch of nerve cells on this.

Q: Does anyone know flutter can build mobile fintech as pre-build framework? A:

Yes, Flutter is fully capable of building a mobile fintech app, and you don’t need to create every widget from scratch.

There are pre-built UI kits available that include dashboards, forms, buttons, and other common components, which can save significant development time. These kits are available for free on GitHub or as paid templates on marketplaces like CodeCanyon and ThemeForest, and can be integrated directly into a Flutter project.

For fintech-specific functionality, third-party SDKs offer ready-made components for payments, authentication, and charts. Libraries like Flutterwave and Stripe provide tools tailored to fintech applications, making it easier to implement core financial features without building them from scratch.
